summary: A promo code shared on X by Mistral AI itself (@MistralAI), not verified by freetokens. The post, dated 2026-11-23, says: “If you’re in Europe, you get a month of Vibe Pro for free.” and “Code: MISTRALVIBE.” It replaces last week’s capped drop: “We ran out of capacity in less than an hour. Today, we’re fixing that for good. No more capped drops.” The post gives no end date.
claim_steps: Open the claim link from Mistral’s thread and sign in to Mistral: https://admin.mistral.ai/subscription/upgrade/redeem?redeem_code=MISTRALVIBE
Use the code MISTRALVIBE. The post says: “If you’re in Europe, you get a month of Vibe Pro for free.”
On who can use it, the post says: “For European builders.” and “No more capped drops.” No end date is given.
Get Vibe desktop from the link in the thread: https://mistral.ai/products/vibe
